content: Implement meal availability toggles (breakfast, morning snack, lunch, afternoon snack, dinner, supper)
Implement Weekly Food Recall component (7 days x enabled meals + extras per day)
Add sleep hours auto-calculation with info card display
Implement lab file upload (image/PDF) with base64 encoding
Improve generation loading screen with elapsed timer and phase messages
Add download plan as .md file button
Update prompt/backend to support multimodal lab file submission
Add data cleaning before submission (remove empty fields, calculate sleep)
End to end testing of all improvements
